From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on DPA / SCC module after today's call

Hi Asha — great to meet today. Quick answers below and an ask for one clarifying point.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Dec 31, 2026. I attached a copy of the report and a 1-page executive summary for Legal (we redact operational details for external distribution). If you need direct read-only access to the full report under an NDA, we can set that up.

Attachment: SOC2-report-2024.pdf (redacted/executive summary)

2) SCC module recommendation: based on your call notes (you act as controller for user content; you asked for embeddings + limited logging), we generally recommend Module 2 (Controller-Processor) SCC flow for standard SaaS processing with Addendum A (data categories + subprocessing list). If you have cross-border subprocessors in non-EEA jurisdictions, we'll include the appropriate commercial terms. If Snova prefers to make Redwood a joint-controller for specific enrichment features, call that out and we'll map responsibilities.

3) Roles statement (short):
- Snova Enterprise: Controller for end-user content and decisions about processing purposes/means.
- Redwood Inference: Processor for data ingestion, tokenization, embeddings generation, and transient KV cache required for inference.
- Logging & telemetry: Redwood collects operational telemetry (latency, error traces) as processor; we provide configurable retention and can exclude PII from telemetry pipelines on request.

Clarifying ask: Are you expecting Redwood to retain embeddings or derived vectors under Snova's control for future queries (i.e., long-term embedding store), or do you want ephemeral embeddings per-request? The SCC module and retention terms are affected by that choice.

Proposed next steps:
- We attach the DPA draft (Docx) for your review — we can send via DocuSign once commercial terms are agreed.
- I'll have our security team complete your vendor questionnaire — can you confirm a target for completion (2 business days / 5 business days)?

I'll loop Lauren who'll coordinate the DocuSign flow and legal touchpoints.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
